name: Oxybutynin
mechanism: M3 muscarinic receptor antagonist reducing detrusor muscle contractions
dosing: Immediate release: 5mg BD-TDS (max 5mg QDS). Modified release: 5-20mg OD
contraindications: Urinary retention, gastric retention, uncontrolled narrow-angle glaucoma, myasthenia gravis
monitoring: Bladder symptoms, post-void residual (if retention risk), cognitive function (elderly)
sideEffects: Dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, cognitive impairment (especially elderly), urinary retention
pharmacokinetics: Hepatic metabolism, first-pass effect, half-life 2-3h (ER formulation has less first-pass)
clinicalPearls: Modified-release better tolerated. High anticholinergic burden - caution elderly. Consider alternatives in dementia
indication: Urge incontinence, overactive bladder, nocturnal enuresis in children >5y
